title: User assertion
purpose: Represent explicit user-supplied evidence separately from sensed observation.

expected.semantic_interpretation: A user assertion is first-class provenance-bearing evidence.
expected.observability: The assertion action is observed directly.
expected.opportunity: No opportunity claim is required for this fixture.
expected.time: Phenomenon, observation/result, and ingestion times remain distinct fields.
expected.provenance: Source platform USER distinguishes the assertion origin.
expected.raw_derived: USER_ASSERTION is not raw sensor evidence or derived observation.
expected.lineage: No correction, deletion, or supersession is asserted.
expected.must_not_infer: Do not infer a routine, preference, habit, or pattern conclusion.
